integrity: Complete symbolic proof with direct finite-field bracket-equation checks; the computations are finite corroborations and not a substitute for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Linear two-local maps only; one-dimensional Heisenberg center; nonlinear two-local maps and larger-center two-step nilpotent algebras are not classified. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Pointwise and pairwise derivation reflexivity in Heisenberg Lie algebras
